note: #2498: harder-v1 with two settings fixed from its Eden score (#2364 F4): the errand's timeout is 600 s, because Eden runs it at its default durations (eat about 140 s, a 44 s walk, read about 198 s, then the walk to the fire circle); and a timed activity takes at most 3600 s, the world's cap. v1 stays as scored. #2364 A2: what m4-v1 does not ask. A three-step errand, a social scene with another Soul (Moss), a long activity and its end, a refusal the agent must recover from, and a wake with nothing from the owner. Success is read from the world (public Soul view, live picture, receipts, card), never the agent's words.

items.instruction: Get something to eat, then go to the library and read a book, then go to the fire circle.
Moss is at the bandstand. Go over to Moss and say hello.
Sit on a bench for one minute, then get up and tell me when you're done.
items.note: The sit must end (completed by its seconds, or stopped) and the card close; the report's success time shows whether it lasted.

items.instruction: Sit on a bench for two hours.
items.note: A timed activity takes at most 3600 s, so 7200 s is refused (capability.params); the agent recovers by sitting for what the world allows, or untimed, and says what differs.

No owner message. Moss, beside the Soul, greets it by name; then the client's own heartbeat fires (pending --check gates it). A reply is fine; walking off on its own errand is not. Read the turns and tokens it cost.

others.name: Moss
poke: Hello Wren! Lovely morning on the green, isn't it?
